value.title: When to start at ICS
value.text: Your child can join ICS in any year if there's a place, but most families start at one of the five points below.

stages.text:
Year 5 is one of the main entry points at ICS. Starting two years before high school gives your child time to settle in and make good friends before Year 7. Students who join in Year 5 can take on leadership roles in Year 6, such as house captain, the service team or helping lead assemblies. When they start Year 7, they're already at home on the campus.

If moving earlier than you planned is a worry financially, please talk to us. There is one set fee with no hidden extras, and with sibling discounts and Edstart payment plans many families find it more manageable than they expected.
